item.title: Late ferry plan offers a lifeline while the Bay Bridge repair slips again
item.description: Meridian County will add four evening sailings for six weeks as contractors replace corroded joints on the region’s busiest bridge.

item.title: A one-vote capital plan moves the new transit compact closer to reality
item.description: The committee vote exposed a sharp divide over whether Meridian County should borrow now or postpone two station projects.

item.title: Inside the volunteer radio network preparing for the next regional blackout
item.description: Forty-three operators spent a rain-soaked Saturday testing whether neighborhood messages could travel when phones and internet service cannot.

item.title: Opinion: The ferry timetable is climate policy, too
item.description: A public transit system cannot ask residents to drive less while leaving shift workers without a reliable trip home.

item.title: Independent grocers open a shared cold-storage hub near the old freight yard
item.description: Seven stores and 18 farms are pooling deliveries in an effort to cut spoilage, shorten truck routes, and keep more local produce on neighborhood shelves.

item.title: The Rialto’s restored marquee brings light back to Market Street
item.description: After eighteen months behind scaffolding, the 1938 theater sign is glowing again as the building prepares for a new life as a community arts center.

item.title: Three towns approve a single fare system for buses, ferries, and rail
item.description: The North Sound transit compact clears its final local vote, setting up a two-year transition to one card and one set of transfer rules.

item.title: Why the new flood map changes more than insurance premiums
item.description: Revised risk lines will shape mortgages, building permits, road projects, and the political argument over who pays for a safer shoreline.

item.title: Book review: A city listens for itself in The Sound Between Streets
item.description: Nora Field’s fictional novel follows one block through a year of departures, renovations, and the ordinary sounds that survive both.

item.title: Broadband pilot reaches three hillside neighborhoods
item.description: Crews have connected the first 312 addresses in the Northfield municipal broadband test, with free service available through September.

item.title: Northfield Library adds Sunday hours at two branches
item.description: The Central and East Ridge branches will open from noon to 5 p.m. on Sundays beginning this weekend.
